dedupe_keys.name: pagasa dam water level updates and river basin flood status philippines

description: PAGASA produced the daily dam water level update for the Angat, Ipo, La Mesa, Ambuklao, Binga, San Roque, Pantabangan, Magat and Caliraya dams, giving the 8 AM reservoir water level, its deviation from the normal high water level and the rule curve, gate openings and estimated flows, together with the flood watch status of 18 major river basins. Coverage is these nine reservoirs and basins in the Philippines. The table is free to view online, with a graph per dam. Caveats: the page shows the current day only, and no download or archive was found on it. Simulation uses: reservoir levels and releases for flood operations and emergency response models. Related records: GRanD (data-grand-global-reservoir-and-dam-database).
